title.narrative: ENHANCING FOOD SECURITY, CLIMATE RESILIENCE AND SUSTAINABLE LIVELIHOODS THROUGH AGROFORESTRY SYSTEMS IN KYERWA DISTRICT

description.narrative: Implemented by FLCAD, the ASILIB-CC project aims to enhance food and nutrition security, climate resilience, and sustainable livelihoods for 5,250 smallholder farming households across 8 wards in Kyerwa District, Kagera Region (Kibare, Kibingo, Businde, Nyaruzumbura, Kyerwa, Rutunguru, Isingiro, and Kamuli). Running from June 2026 to December 2028, the project addresses soil degradation and climate stress by integrating agroforestry, Sustainable Agricultural Land Management (SALM), climate-smart agriculture, gender-inclusive enterprise development, and nutrition awareness.

activity-date.narrative: ENHANCING FOOD SECURITY, CLIMATE RESILIENCE AND SUSTAINABLE LIVELIHOODS THROUGH AGROFORESTRY SYSTEMS IN KYERWA DISTRICT

recipient-country.narrative: The Foundation for Local Capacity in Agricultural Development (FLCAD) is implementing this initiative to strengthen community resilience through sustainable agriculture, environmental conservation, and improved nutrition. The project directly addresses the impacts of climate change by capacity-building smallholder farmers in climate-smart agricultural practices, promoting ecosystem restoration, and improving household food and nutrition security for vulnerable rural populations.
